 Amul launches High Protein Cubes in five flavours
 The product contains 65% protein, is priced at Rs 80 and is available through the Amul Shop app and website.
 afaqs! news bureau 
 31 Oct 2026 
 13:01
 IST Follow Us
 New Update Amul has launched High Protein Cubes, a savoury snack containing 25 g of protein and 150 calories in a 38 g single-serve pack.
 The product, which the company says contains 65% protein, is priced at Rs 80 and is available through the Amul Shop app and website. Amul announced the launch through a post on its official Instagram account.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Amul - The Taste of India (@amul_india) 
 Shefali Vijaywargiya, brand manager at GCMMF (Amul), also shared details about the product in a post on X.
 Amul High Protein Cubes A savoury snack with 65% protein! 25 g protein in a 38 g pack with only 150 kcal and priced at Rs 80. A box of 5 single-serve packs comes with 5 seasoning tastemaker sachets in Peri Peri, Korean Kimchi, Tandoori, Cheese & Herbs, and Tomato flavours. How to consume: Pour the tastemaker sachet into the cubes pack, give it a shake, and your seasoning-coated crunchy snack is ready! You can also drop it into gravies for protein-rich meals or soups for a crouton-like bite. Or make a quick, crunchy bhel with onions, tomatoes, and chutneys. We’d love to see the innovative ways you consume Amul High Protein Cubes. Available now on the Amul Shop app and website. Link in comments.
— Shefali Vijaywargiya (@Shefali_Vj) October 30, 2026 
 According to Amul’s Instagram post, the product is sold in a box of five single-serve packs, with each pack accompanied by a seasoning sachet. The flavours include Peri Peri, Korean Kimchi, Tandoori, Cheese & Herbs and Tomato.
 Consumers can pour the seasoning into the pack, shake it and eat the cubes as a snack. The product can also be added to gravies, soups or used to make a crunchy bhel with onions, tomatoes and chutneys, according to Amul.
 The launch adds another product to Amul’s growing high-protein portfolio. The cooperative launched its high-protein direct-to-consumer range in 2022, beginning with products such as high-protein paneer and dahi.
 The portfolio has since expanded to include lassi, buttermilk, milkshakes and whey protein. In 2025, Amul also launched high-protein milk and mango kulfi.
 In April 2025, the cooperative introduced high-protein mango kulfi containing 10 g of protein and 57 calories per 60 g pack, priced at Rs 40. At the time, managing director Jayen Mehta said the company was planning more protein-focused products, including snacks.
 The High Protein Cubes mark an extension of that portfolio into the ready-to-eat snack category.
